notes.title: Free Expansion: Gamble Tower All In is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It is finally here!
Not much else to say, just a lot of patch notes to unravel.

Go play it now! Just download the latest update and you'll be set! :)

[b]Just some more info:[/b]
[olist]
[*] I don't remember everything we added, so there will be a lot that you won't see on the patch notes, go play it to find out new stuff!
[*] We'll keep patching the game with bugfixes, QOL and more! If you find any bugs, crashes or have any suggestions please report it to us on [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]our Discord[/url] or through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1577460/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].
[*] While I don't guarantee new content we really want to modify and have some new Traits (and new Achievements), since we ran out of time to do that this [i]might[/i] happen in a future smaller content patch.
[*] I may play the game live or on YouTube in order to find new bugs and also to create some guides for the unlocks, I'll let you guys know if this actually ends up happening.
[*] Have lots of fun!
[/olist]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Balancing and Revamps[/h2]
[h3]Loadouts[/h3]
[list]
[*] Elf’s “Druid” loadout was modified (Added Domesticate)
[*] Human’s “Engineer” loadout was modified. (Added Turret)
[*] Human’s “Berserker” loadout was modified. (Added Berserk Hit)
[*] Elven Charm now triggers upon using 0 cost orbs instead of triggering when using an orb while you have 0 mana.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revamped Inn Master at the Tower, she should now sell drink artifacts.
[/list]
[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]Major Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] MacZee now appears at the Tower and the Inn after being unlocked, allowing you to customize loadouts and change initial artifacts.
[*] Added 18 new acquirable upgrade crystals. (unlock them at the Inn)
[*] Added more than 15 new neutral orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added several new Elf orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added several new Human orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added several new Demon orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added 15 new acquirable and unlockable artifacts.
[*] Added acquirable shop and gamble rerolls.
[*] Added Elite Mode
[*] Added 3 new bosses.
[*] Added a new miniboss
[*] Added two final endings: One for those seeking closure, and another for those seeking wealth.
[*] Most enemies now have Elite counterparts, totalizing 12 new enemies. (and Elite capturable orbs)
[*] Added 6 new clan loadouts.
[*] You can buy 5 unique non-clan characters and pets from a new secret salesman, including a duck.
[*] Added 7 new Tower Dangers, including 3 Elite Dangers. (12 Tower Dangers in Total)
[*] Added Elite Gambles, which include plenty of new rewards, punishes and challenges.
[*] Added several new events. (And rebalanced odds of events appearing for better distribution)
[*] Added the Elite Skill Tier, which adds 3 new Elite Skills for each clan. (9 new Skills total)
[/list]
[h3]Art[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remade the Rainstorm Background
[*] Since the new Backgrounds is rendered natively using Particles instead of using a Video Player, this should increase the compatibility in certain systems (Because Unity’s Video Player can be a bit problematic).
[*] Improved the Lighting on Character Rendering, allowing certain body parts/textures to glow in the dark.
[*] Added VFXs for multiple Status Effects, including both new and existing ones.
[/list]
[h3]Progression[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Clan Level Cap from 4 to 8.
[*] Increased Gambler Level Cap from 5 to 10.
[/list]
[h2]NPCs[/h2]
[list]
[*] MacZee can now appear at the Inn and the Tower after being unlocked.
[*] Krystaloblin can now appear at the Inn after being unlocked.
[*] A secret someone can appear at the Inn after being unlocked.
[/list]
[h2]Artifacts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “Compass” Human Loadout Artifact
[*] Added “Evil Runestone” Demon Loadout Artifact
[*] Added “Magic Plant” Elf Loadout Artifact
[*] Added 12+ other artifacts both for Neutral and Clans.
[/list]
[h2]Orbs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 11 new clan orbs for loadouts.
[*] Added Grapple (Human Wrestler)
[*] Added Toss (Human Wrestler)
[*] Added Wrestling Bandana (Human Wrestler)
[*] Added Turret (Human Engineer)
[*] Added Berserk Hit (Demon Berserker)
[*] Added Sampling (Demon Metamorph)
[*] Added Metamorphosis (Demon Metamorph)
[*] Added Metamorph’s Trident (Demon Metamorph)
[*] Added Domesticate (Elf Druid)
[*] Added Elven Charge (Elf Shaman)
[*] Added Shamanic Ritual (Elf Shaman)
[*] Added a bunch of new capturable orbs
[*] Added a bunch of new neutral orbs
[*] Added a bunch of new clan orbs
[/list]
[h2]Loadouts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added acquirable “Shaman” loadout for Elf Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Metamorph” loadout for Demon Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Wrestler” loadout for Human Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Dealer” loadout for Elf Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Cheater” loadout for Demon Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Risktaker” loadout for Human Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added 6 new clan loadout artifacts. (2 for each clan)
[*] Added 5 special character loadouts
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added lots of new voicelines.
[*] Added lots of new songs.
[*] All endings are now (basically) fully voiced.
[/list]
[h2]HUD[/h2]
[list]
[*] HUD Elements for Gambles were completely redesigned.
[*] Certain Gambles (Such as “No Repetition”) will now show important information related to them.
[*] Round/Turn HUD Element was also completely redesigned.
[*] Pet Pouch and Artifact Pouch buttons were moved to the Left Side, alongside the rest of your Character’s Loadout.
[*] The Combat Speed option is now hidden, until you hover the mouse above the Gear Menu. (It will show up for 5s when the combat starts to point out its existence).
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Character Selection Screen was completely redesigned.
[*] This also includes the information about your characters on the Gear Menu (Pause).
[*] Added an Option to skip the Intro under Settings -> Interface
[*] Warning: Skipping the intro will also skip the Epilepsy Warning.
[*] Revamped the Credits Section.
[*] Revamped the Skill Allocation Menu to accommodate for Elite Skills and provide better feedback on Skill Point Cost/Limit.
[*] The Gamble Selection Menu on the Intersection was redesigned to accommodate 4 Gambles being displayed.
[/list]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some Particle Effects can be Controlled by a Quality Setting in the Options menu, including the new Rainstorm Effect and Many other Particle Effects.
[*] Tower Dangers now remain selected between expeditions
[*] You can now discard Characters and Pets.
[*] Added a button to clear all Tower Dangers selected.
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] [PT-BR] Localized all of the dialogues that were missing Localization
[*] [PT-BR] Localized multiple missing strings on the Skill HUD
[*] [PT-BR] Localized some tooltips on the Intersection
[*] [PT-BR] Localized the Epilepsy Warning
[*] [PT-BR] Localized the Credits and the Main Menu Discord Button.
[*] [PT-BR] Localized tooltips for Flames and Banished Pile
[*] With this, the game should be fully localized in PT-BR.
[*] Se você encontrar algum texto não traduzido, ou algum erro de tradução, por favor reporte o erro para nós.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[i]Please note that I don't actually remember all the bugs that we fixed, we probably fixed a lot more.
(That doesn't stop new ones from appearing though :<)[/i]
[h3]Most Important Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would softlock if a character with the “Sped up” buff died before acting.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game wouldn’t pause when you entered the Gear Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips would disappear permanently.
[*] Fixed an issue where Janitor would appear multiple times at the ending.
[/list]
[h3]Functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where round was sometimes instantly skipped when the first enemy in the queue died before acting.
[*] Fixed issue where Sleeping characters wouldn’t show the “My Turn” widget.
[/list]
[h3]UI and UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Caffeine Addict should no longer leave Sleep as a 0 stack ailment, it won’t appear at all instead.
[*] Mana Cost should no longer appear on the top of the Lootbox animations anymore
[/list]
[h3]Audiovisual[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Mana values would appear above Boss Lootbox.
[*] Better aligned target areas for some characters like Drakobold
[*] Broken Toys should no longer visually affect artifacts if the gamble is inactive.
[/list]
[h3]Localization and Text[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where names would not be localized in temporary dialogues.
[*] Fixed issue where “Discarded” would appear on Upgrade Crystal frames.
[*] Fixed a bunch of weird localization issues.
[/list]

Thank you for stopping by!

notes.title: Sneak Peek: It is almost here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I hope you are doing well.
It has been almost one month since we announced the All In Expansion/Update. I am here to talk a bit about the release and reveal some more details while we are at it.
([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1577460/announcements/detail/3798284112471177965?snr=2_9_100003_]You can read more here[/url])

[h1]Release Plan[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/H9XyN91.gif[/img]
[i](Our new characters also want to know about that!)[/i]

As discussed in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1577460/announcements/detail/3798284112471177965?snr=2_9_100003_]previous post[/url], we planned two releases:
[list]
[*] Unstable Version - [i]Late November[/i] (which is already up for our [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord members[/url])
[*] Stable Version - [i]Early December[/i]
[/list]
A brief recap to explain the version differences: 

[b]Unstable[/b] is a buggy and unstable version of the update, accessible only as a password protected beta for anyone in our [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord[/url].

and [b]Stable[/b] is the public version that is planned to be released as a regular update, as soon as it is released it you'll be able to download it just by updating your game.

[h2]When is Stable coming?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ux0MTEv.gif[/img]
[i](What an unstable guy!)[/i]

While I did not confirm any solid date, the expected date of December 9th announced in the previous post seems no longer feasible.
The update is very close to finished, it is already fully playable and has all necessary content for release but we still need to sort out some time consuming details, which I am going detail below.

[h2]What is missing[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kNLaPrl.gif[/img]
In summary, the main pending elements for the release are:
[list]
[*] Some new Events
[*] Some Voice Acting
[*] Elite Skill Tree Icons
[*] Implement all pending Clan and Neutral Orbs.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3HpeT5N.gif[/img]
The most time consuming of those are the new events[i] (which we are tackling right now)[/i], as they usually require everything: voice acting, art, SFX, music and coding.
Each event usually takes 1 to 2 full days of development, which is why we had to delay the planned release date a bit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TL8rBBT.png[/img]
Skill Tree icons also take some time, Jaqueta and Erik are currently handling those, and I expect to be able to help them at some point after finishing event and orb implementation.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IByrBXF.gif[/img]
And finally, while Orb implementation and art are not super time consuming (I can usually add multiple in one day) making new Summons and Equipments are usually on the slower side of development, [b]specially [/b]Summons, as they need to be rigged and animated.

[h3]Any dates?[/h3]
We are going to release Stable version on or before December 17th.

[h1]End[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8byMfeZh.gif[/img]
[i](Ouch.)[/i]

I know that was a brief sneak peek, but I sincerely hope that this new update adds a ton more gameplay and replayability to the game.
And more importantly, that you have fun with it!

See you soon!
- Ian.

notes.title: Announcing the All In Expansion
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are doing fantastic!
I come here today to proudly announce the [b]All In Expansion[/b] for Gamble Tower!

[h1]What is the All In Expansion?[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CTkiiXB.png[/img]
You can call it the All In Expansion, All In Update or just 1.1.
This is the final name for the update that we were previously naming 1.1.

[h2]What does it add?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WXKL6Rw.gif[/img]
[i](What a full Inn!)[/i]
We are adding a lot of content, doubling a lot of the existing variety of content currently in the game.
So this includes things such as:
[list]
[*] 18 new Upgrade Crystals
[*] 16 new Artifacts
[*] 6 new Clan Loadouts (2 for each clan)
[*] Rerolls for everything! (Gambles, shops, etc.)
[*] 3 new Elite boss fights.
[*] 3 new Inn NPCs.
[*] 8 new Tower Dangers, including 3 Elite Tower Dangers
[*] Level caps are doubled! Clans now go up to level 8 and Gambler up to level 10!
[*] Elite Gambles!
[*] New events!
[*] New acquirable Orbs, both for clans and neutral ones!
[*] Elite variants for every enemy in the game. (essentially 12 new enemies)
[*] And more!
[/list]
[h2]Why "All In?"[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ptKUS5H.gif[/img]
I wanted something gamble themed, we thought about "[b]High Stakes[/b]", "[b]Double or Nothing[/b]" and some other ones, but in the end I think that "[b]All In[/b]" was the proper one.
Being the first and last major update planned for Gamble Tower, I think it is a good name.

[h3]Last Update?[/h3]
This is the last content update planned, but we will still update the game with bugfixes, balancing patches and quality of life features.
Nothing is stopping us from releasing other content updates and expansions in the future, but I think it is important to be clear that there is currently no plans for that.

[h2]When will it release?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bg4zHp4.gif[/img]
There will be two releases:

[h3]Unstable[/h3]
The Unstable version will be a less polished (and realistically, unstable/buggy) version available later this month [i](November 2023)[/i] on a specific password-protected Steam branch.
If you want to help us playtest the update and have early access to it, [url=https://discord.com/invite/4N2UWEx]join our discord.[/url]
We'll announce the password that you need to insert on the game's settings on Steam in order to access this version, but only on Discord. (we want to keep the playtest manageable.)

[h3]Stable[/h3]
The Stable version is the proper release of the update, it is planned to be available early December.
Anyone who owns Gamble Tower will have access to this expansion just by downloading the latest Steam update when it is available.
If everything goes as planned, expect it to be available around December 9th.

[h2]Will you show some of the content?[/h2]
Yes! Let's do it.
[i]Please be aware that content shown here is work in progress![/i]

[h1]Elites! Elites Everywhere![/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rAdqyy0.gif[/img]
A big part of this update is that I wanted to really amp-up the difficulty for those players who are seeking a bigger challenge, therefore we decided to add what we call [b]Elite Mode[/b].

[h2]How to get it?[/h2]
Elite Mode is unlocked upon finding the Janitor or reaching the top while having 5 Tower Dangers active. If you already did that, when you start the game with [b]All In Expansion[/b], it will be automatically unlocked.

[h2]What is it?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XrHJUHn.gif[/img]
After being unlocked, Elite Mode is activated if you have a Danger Level of 3 or more. [i](each Tower Danger active will increase the Danger Level by 1, Elite Tower Dangers increase it by 3.)[/i]

In essence, Elite Mode enables Elite Gambles which then enables Elite Enemies and Elite Bosses. 

[h2]Why would I do it?[/h2]
There are several unlockables that you can only unlock by defeating Elite bosses, rewards are much more generous in this mode and you get more XP/GC.
But the main idea is, of course, providing a bigger challenge than ever before.

[h1]What else?[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3CC0F82.gif[/img]
I think that is it for now! I prefer that you play the game and discover the content by yourself, I also dislike overpromising, so I just announced what we already have developed.
We plan to keep adding variety (specially Orbs, Events, maybe Skills and Traits) until the release happens.

Until then, I hope you look forward into playing our update!
See you next time, and remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/4N2UWEx]join our discord[/url] to play the expansion early!

- Ian

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Loadout Customization and Bank NPC
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Now that September is over, we are finally able to focus on the brand new update for Gamble Tower: 1.1!

As promised, here is a sneak peek of some of the features that are going to be present in this new content patch, please remember that everything you see is still a big W.I.P!

[h1]Before the sneak peek[/h1]
[b]We got a developer page! Please follow us![/b] :)
https://store.steampowered.com/dev/indiebuild


If you want frequent updates, we have several secondary platforms where we post Gamble Tower content that you may wish to follow or join, based on frequency:
[list]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx][b]Discord[/b] [i](very frequent updates)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiebuild][b]Twitch[/b] [i](used to be daily, now it's usually weekly)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/@Indiebuild][b]YouTube[/b] [i](monthly-ish...?)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/gambletower][b]X?[/b] [i](our good friend Erik handles this platform)[/i][/url]
[/list]
[h1]The Bank[/h1]
After showing the concept art for the bank NPC for so long, I am glad to announce that he is finally [b]in-game and almost fully implemented![/b] and he is fully 3D! (Because why not?)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/d2SXGX2.gif[/img]
Stebanks MacZee shows up [b]both at the Inn and at the Tower[/b] after you pay the ludicrous amount of 10.000 gold coins to Inn Master. [i](you need to be at Gambler Level 5)[/i]

He provides different services in the different locations he appears, so we'll showcase them separately.

[h2]Bank at Expeditions[/h2]
During expeditions, MacZee has a chance to appear as an intersection NPC on the left side of the Gambler, just like Stebax and Inn Master.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZT5msZd.gif[/img]

He'll provide you with two different banking services when you talk to him:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KyKswoh.png[/img]

[h3]Currency Banking (Withdrawal and Deposit)[/h3]
If you are overflowing with cash, you can conveniently exchange your Inn's gold coins for Gambling Chips by using the withdrawal service.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/08KZ4yj.png[/img]
This allows you to get up to 500 GC per encounter with MacZee. [i](It is a 2:1 exchange rate though, so you will pay 1000 coins per 500 GC.)[/i]

If you are not feeling that rich or if you have A LOT of chips and are afraid of dying early, you can safely deposit as many GC you want and instantly convert them into Inn Gold Coins for posterior usage.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8gG6FCb.png[/img]
It is a fair exchange rate of 1:1 in this case, no fees for this service.

[h3]Item Storage (Retrieve and Store Orbs)[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CrDaqsz.gif[/img]
You may safely store a limited amount of orbs inside Stebanks, be it to make your pouch lighter or to retrieve them later.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZtfcwSR.gif[/img]
The fee is a bit hefty [i](100 GC per storage and retrieval)[/i] but [b]items persist in between expeditions[/b]! So nothing will stop you from storing and retrieving orbs that would otherwise be VERY difficult to get early on or from completely different clans than what you are playing!

[h3]Bank Artifacts[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VqLoDMe.png[/img]
MacZee may or may not sell/give some random bank artifacts like Credit Cards and Lottery Tickets.
We are still testing those and seeing if they work well.
[b]I cannot say for sure if they are going to be present in the final version or not, so take this "sneak peek" with a big grain of salt.[/b]

[h2]Bank at the Inn[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RwxoAad.gif[/img]
At the Inn, MacZee allows you to upgrade its multitude of banking services and [b]customize your loadout[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5ONGPGa.png[/img]
I am not going to spoil all the upgrades you can acquire from him, but some allow a pretty cool degree of customization, I think. (keep in mind, it is [u][b]expensive[/b][/u])

[h3]Loadout Customization[/h3]
You can use the orbs that you stored during expeditions to customize your pets and character loadouts [b]permanently[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vL2sfWZ.png[/img]
The way it works, you use orbs stored on the safe to replace up to a certain amount of orbs (upgradeable) from your character's loadout.
Each orb customized makes the price go up though, so be prepared to open up your wallet.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tJCc9bI.png[/img]
This allows you to create pretty strong and wild loadouts! Believe me, you are going to need all the help you can find [b]when facing all the new challenges this patch adds.[/b]

[h1]More Stuff?[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eDlym95.png[/img]
[i](little game: find the NPC that wasn't there before)[/i]

I only covered some of the Bank features in this post, but the patch is planned to add an array of new things for you to unlock, find, fight and do.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ahgVhqN.png[/img]
[i](We didn't even got to show the new artifacts yet...)[/i]

I think that for this sneak peek we already have shown a good amount of content, so expect more to be shown on the upcoming weeks.

[h1]End[/h1]
I sometimes get a [i]biiiit[/i] afraid of showing too much as well, because we never know when we have to cut corners :p 
(Don't wanna hype anyone up unnecessarily)

Everything I've shown so far is confirmed to be there though. (Except bank artifacts, we'll see.)

Anyway, I hope you liked this sneak peek! 
Thank you so much for all your support and see you soon!

notes.title: Our Update Schedule
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thank you so much for the amazing support!
This is a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1577460/announcements/detail/3671051077326200566?snr=2_9_100003_]follow up from the previous post[/url] where I'll tell you everything that we have decided related to the updates.

[h2]Reminder[/h2]
I mentioned this on our previous post as well, but here it is again:
If you want frequent updates, we have several secondary platforms where we post Gamble Tower content that you may wish to follow or join, based on frequency:
[list]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx][b]Discord[/b] [i](very frequent updates)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiebuild][b]Twitch[/b] [i](used to be daily, now it's usually weekly)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/@Indiebuild][b]YouTube[/b] [i](monthly-ish...?)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/gambletower][b]X?[/b] [i](our good friend Erik handles this platform)[/i][/url]
[/list]
We usually reserve Steam announcements for big stuff, but since the game is now out, I'll try to be a bit more frequent around here!
So feel free to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1577460/Gamble_Tower/]follow us here through our Steam Page[/url] as well! (We'll also make a developer page, ...eventually.)

[h1]In Short[/h1]
[h2]Schedule Summary[/h2]
[i]If you don't want to read everything, I won't blame you! Here is a summary of our schedule:[/i]
[olist]
[*] [b]Sep 1st - Sep 8th[/b]: Daily hotfixes. (for most part)
[*] [b]Sep 9th - Sep 30th[/b]: Weekly hotfixes + QOL, we'll be focusing on making the game as stable (and less annoying) as we can.
[*] [b]Oct 1st - Oct 31st[/b]: Weeklyish hotfixes, Focus on QOL + we'll start proper development on the next content patch, expect more sneak peeks and news around this time.
[*] [b]November[/b]: Full focus on 1.1 Update, we'll try to release it around the end of the month.
[*] [b]December[/b]: Frequent hotfixes for 1.1 Update, we'll probably plan more stuff around this time.
[/olist]
[h2]1.1 Update Content Summarized[/h2]
[i]Now, if you want to know the [b]confirmed[/b] content we have planned for 1.1:[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]Bank NPC[/b]: Unlocked after you amass some amount of money, will allow for things related to retrieving and storing gold, chips... orbs? Shenanigans [i]may[/i] include a credit card.
[*] [b]New Loadouts[/b]: Starting deck variety, as well as a secondary starting artifact for each clan.
[*] [b]New Tower Dangers[/b]: More difficulties! [i]...I guess you guys like that?[/i]
[*] [b]New Orbs[/b]: Specially for clans!
[*] [b]Late Game Content[/b]: Some of you already unlocked almost everything, somehow! I am happy! So we'll have more for you.
[*] [b]And more![/b]
[/list]
[h1]Now, the Details[/h1]
[h2]Hotfixes and Stability[/h2]
Probably the most important situation to address is that yes, Gamble Tower is pretty unstable, and I deeply apologize for it.
There is a lot of different reasons, but here is no place for excuses. (I'll be making a video for our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Indiebuild]YouTube channel[/url] explaining why, if you are interested!)

[h3]Launch Week[/h3]
[b]More importantly is[/b]: that during this week we are trying to deploy hotfixes almost every single day (yesterday was an exception), and we hope to be able to provide a much more stable experience by the end of the week.
We are doing everything in our power to fix the plethora of bugs and lack of QOL that are popping up, so please, feel free to continue sending any issues that you find through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1577460/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord[/url]!

It's only through your reports that we become aware of some bugs, and some reports are so helpful that they help us understand what is happening and how to fix it! So don't be shy!
You are helping Gamble Tower become a better game! :)

[h3]Post-Launch Week[/h3]
[b]However![/b] I cannot keep this frequency up for post-launch.
And as such from the next week onwards [b]we'll be deploying 1 to 2 hotfixes per week[/b] instead of daily.
[i](There may be more, but that is the amount that we can promise to have.)[/i]

We are not full time devs, so during weekdays I usually only have the early morning and the very late night to do develop, which unfortunately is not enough for deploying a significant amount or quality of fixes that you guys deserve.

Another reason is that some bugs and QOL features NEED time, specially when they involve changing how something works. (refactoring stuff.)
If we rush fixing things, we'll end breaking more stuff than we are fixing, so I hope you understand.

[h2]1.1 Content Planning[/h2]
[i]Yes, we made a tier list. Actually... [b]four[/b] tier lists.[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/v67TIxJ.png[/img]

We still need to meet and plan the [i]nitty'n gritty[/i] of everything we plan to add, but we managed to at least confirm most of the core content we wish to have for the 1.1.
[i][b]disclaimer[/b]: tier list subject to change.[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wp7ZHa0.png[/img]

Basically, the tier lists for each one of us (Ian, Camila and Jaqueta) is just a tool to express what we [b]can[/b] and [b]want to[/b] have in the game the most.
There is some content we really wanted to add but it is completely unviable development-wise, reasons usually include: too much development time, having to rebuild core systems from scratch or the infamous "this will certainly break all the other systems".

[h3]After 1.1 Update (1.2?)[/h3]
We'll decide and plan when we are there (well, a little bit [i]before[/i] that, I hope). 
But for most part, if something doesn't make the cut for 1.1, we'll transfer that to another patch, if feasible.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
That is it for now! Hopefully we'll be able to share some more info and update sneak peeks soon!
See you later! 

- Ian

notes.title: Announcing the Release Date
notes.content:

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
First off, thank you all so very much for playing our game.
It meant a lot to us.

Now, as previously announced... The Playtest 2 comes to an end.
We talked a little bit about this on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1577460/announcements/detail/3701439593989067436]previous post[/url], but you might be wondering, what is next?

[h2]What the Playtest lacked[/h2]
Before talking about this, I want to apologize, as I wasn't able to finish all the features that I wanted to test on the playtest in time. (Bank NPC, Boss Lootbox)
As such, the current plan is to move those features to our next big milestone, which is [b]The Prologue[/b].

Thanks to all of you we managed to fix a lot of bugs and issues during the Playtest, as well as implement lots of suggestions that I truly believe made the game better.
With all that said, I believe that this Playtest accomplished its original goal.

[h2]What comes next[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hg6SWxZ.png[/img]
We just ended our Playtest, so the next goal is to make a free to play version of the game, called "The Prologue".
It will work just like a demo, but it will have its own Steam Page and will be released as a separate game entirely.

[h2]What will be in the Prologue[/h2]
The Prologue will have the entire first segment/chapter, a simpler version of the Inn, a revamped Tutorial system and some new features like the Bank NPC and Boss Lootboxes.
I will certainly make another post when we have everything sorted out and ready for presentation. (Possibly even a video!)

[h2]Why make a Prologue and not a new demo[/h2]
The original idea was to make an updated demo for the game, and you could consider the prologue just that.
However, since the Prologue is considered inside Steam as a entirely separate game (and more importantly, a separate game release), the amount of visibility it gathers is muuuch higher than just a demo.

This will allow us to reach new players that never would have heard about Gamble Tower or tried the game otherwise.

[h2]Release dates[/h2]
We currently have two milestones left to go, The Prologue is estimated to be released somewhere between the months of June, July and August. (but the Steam Page will be on before that, so I'll make a new post when the time comes)

For the final release there is no solid date yet, but we believe it will come not far after the Prologue's release, as we'll be working on features for both the Prologue and the final game simultaneously.

When we have a fully defined date we'll make a post announcing that as well.

[h2]Thank you.[/h2]
Thank you for your continued support of Gamble Tower, we'll keep working to make the game better than ever.
See you guys soon! :D

notes.title: Playtest Halted
notes.content:
Hello everyone, sorry to be the bearer of bad news.

So, yes, we'll be halting the Closed Beta/Steam Playtest that was supposed to go on until December 12th.
You may have a couple of questions and be wondering why that is the case, so let me explain:

[h3]When?[/h3]
If you are reading this, it's probably already done.
I wanted to put some kind of notice earlier but I got really sick again, so I wasn't able to do that.

[h3]Why?[/h3]
Save System issues, a LOT of issues.
To be more specific:
- Saves could crash the game as soon as it opened.
- Saves between versions (eg. v1.0 vs 1.1) could potentially be breaking, so a save made in v1 would not work in v1.1
- Autosaves creating endless saves
- Saves sometimes just didn't work and you would lose all your data
Among other issues...

Besides that, there were the other many bugs, soft lockes and things like that.
(Which we already expected, but weren't able to handle properly due to those save problems)

[h3]Can't you just fix it?[/h3]
We tried a lot of different stuff, but it seems like we'll have to create an entire new save system since nothing that we tried actually ended up being fruitful.
That was my mistake, I should have tested the save system further before making the playtest available, and for that I am sorry.

[h3]Will it return?[/h3]
Yes, but we don't know when yet.
I'll be announcing a date in the future, but only after those save issues have been confirmed as fixed.
However, since we are approaching the end of the year, it's reasonable to expect that the beta will be back January or February.

[h3]End[/h3]
With all that said, we are sorry, and I wish to thank everyone who played the closed beta until this point.
All the feedbacks, bug reports and playthroughs of the game helped us a lot and seeing so many people playing the game made us very happy.

See you again soon!

notes.title: CLOSED BETA DATE REVEAL!
notes.content:
Hello folks, I am happy to announce that Gamble Tower's closed beta will be held from...

 [b]November 29th to December 12th[/b]!

To commemorate that, I also made a video showcasing some of the beta:
[previewyoutube=2v4YuQUxtZo;full][/previewyoutube]

This announcement was made to provide you with some other details, in case you are interested in taking part.

[h3]How can I participate?[/h3]
A "Request Access" button will be available on our Steam page soon, we'll be announcing it first hand on our [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord[/url], but we'll also make another announcement here on Steam to make everybody aware of that.

[h3]Is this access permanent?[/h3]
No, for those who request access via Steam, the closed beta will end December 12th, so you will be able to play the game from November 29th until December 12th, after that you will no longer have access to the beta.

[h3]I already have a key, do I have access to the beta?[/h3]
Yes, if you got a full game key from me or one of the devs, you will also have access to the closed beta.
We'll be uploading the same closed beta version on both sides.
The only difference is that those with keys will be able to play the beta even after the official beta period ends. (Essentially, until the final game releases)

[h3]Can I get permanent access?[/h3]
If you are a streamer, youtuber, influencer or just plan to play the beta on video when it launches.
Just send me your channel/info through email, contact me: indiebuild@gmail.com
We [i]may[/i] be able to send you a full key free of charge, no guarantees though.

If you already played the game on video/stream previously, you may want to wait a bit as we'll be sending keys for you very soon. (Yes, I do watch every video and stream that I am aware of :p)

[h3]Is this Early Access?[/h3]
No, this is a free beta, you'll be able to participate free of charge while the beta goes on.

[h3]Why is the closed beta temporary?[/h3]
Mainly because we need to be readily available during the weeks that the beta will be held, as we'll have to provide quick hotfixes, collect feedback/bugs and be able to communicate with the community in a faster pace than we usually can.

Besides that, we plan to keep working on the full game (using the feedback gathered to shape it a little bit better) as soon as the beta ends, so having an endless beta wouldn't be ideal for development.

[h3]How can I share feedback?[/h3]
We'll be adding in-game buttons for bug reports/suggestions/feedback. 
We'll also be providing a form (you'll have in-game access to that) with several important questions that will help us understand better how you feel about the game and what can we do to improve what we currently have.
After the beta ends, you'll still be able to give us your feedback through the Steam community or our discord.

[h3]Ending[/h3]
With that said, I hope that you are able to participate and give us your thoughts about Gamble Tower.
I am very excited to share the progress with you and hopefully it will be a cool experience for everyone.

Thank you for your patience and see you later this month! :)

notes.title: We are back!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It has been a while.
I hope you like our new Steam capsule arts, I decided to change it preemptively before the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/6232436041608114695]capsule policies[/url] send our visibility deep into the abyss, haha.

[h2]Summary[/h2]
A lot happened since the last dev update that we posted here, and I wanted to just keep you guys updated and aware of what has been going on with Gamble Tower's development.

[h3]What happened to Early Access? What about Closed Beta?[/h3]
Previously I released a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xea9oS1g1uE&t=253s&ab_channel=IndiebuildTeam]"small" video[/url] where I talked about some release dates for both the game (Early Access at the time) and the closed beta, this video is now of course largely inaccurate as [u]our game is no longer going to be available under Early Access[/u] and the Closed Beta has been delayed to a TBD date for now.

[h2]Closed Beta[/h2]
[h3]But why it didn't happen?[/h3]
The closed beta has been delayed due to a lot of things happening on our personal lives currently, for instance, I had to spend almost the entire month of June and July moving to another town - Finding a place, signing contracts, fixing-up our previous apartment and things like that.

Essentially, life happened, and I apologize profusely for announcing yet another release date that we couldn't meet. - It won't happen again.

I explained a little bit more thoroughly on our [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord[/url], but from now on we won't announce any release dates until what has been announced is already 99% finished.
I think it's a good policy to apply, right?

[h3]Will it happen?[/h3]
Yes, we are reorganizing ourselves to be able to actually hold our Closed Beta as soon as possible, content-wise the game is already very close to what we want to have in CB.
I would say that [u]the CB is around 70% done[/u], but I can't announce a date until we finish the remaining 29% to reach the previously said 99%.[i] (Complicated numbers, eh?)[/i]

[h2]No more Early Access?[/h2]
No, we decided to not release Gamble Tower under the Early Access anymore.

[h3]Why?[/h3]
Actually, the original plan (on the starting development months) was to release it as a full game, the idea to put it as an EA title came from the fact that we had a [u]very tight deadline[/u] that we had to rigorously follow at the time: To release it on [i]15th of May of 2020[/i]
Since we weren't going to be able to finish the ENTIRE game in less than six months, we changed it into Early Access.

[h3]What? Why did that deadline exist?[/h3]
[b]Long story short:[/b] I was working as a freelancer, and my contract theoretically would end on May 2020, which would leave me and my fiancee completely buckless, no money for bills, rent, etc. - Therefore we had until then to finish and release the game.

Gamble Tower actually emerged as a fun side project, that turned into an actual [u]product[/u] because of the fact that we HAD to get money somehow. And that was the only way I thought that we could do that back then.
This entire idea of trying to get money with the first indie game of course was COMPLETELY flawed and naive for a variety of reasons, but again, we don't exactly think straight when we go indie, eh?

[h3]What now?[/h3]
As you might expect, I ended up getting other revenue sources and decided to spend more time making Gamble Tower a better experience and just a better game in general, without the need to rush it.

Currently we (me and my fiancee) are doing well financially, however due to that we don't have as much time as we had back then, so following strict deadlines, release dates and (if we were to release Gamble Tower in Early Access) roadmaps is out of question right now.

[h3]So...?[/h3]
Okay, so now that you understand all of this... [i]complicated development hell nonsense[/i].
It's easier to understand that I just prefer to release Gamble Tower as a complete and fun title from the start, so that we can focus on just bugfixing and polishing after release, instead of having to follow roadmaps and deadlines without being able to.

[h2]Wheeen?[/h2]
Soon, my friends.
I hope we are able to release the closed beta soon, and provide the full Gamble Tower experience later this year.

See you all soon!

As you can see we can finally show you the Inn, There are new and familiar characters here! This is the place you go to in between expeditions, and it is where most of the meta-progression part of the game happens.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vPHgAM7.gif[/img]

You can acquire new orbs, new artifacts and new general upgrades (like a shop reroll) that will appear on future expeditions as soon as you buy them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BQP6CRY.png[/img]

Certain items and upgrades will only unlock when you reach specific levels, and there are currently four different types of levels.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DcwHfuq.png[/img]

You have levels for each clan, you will unlock things for that specific clan by levelling it up by playing characters that belong to that clan.
There is also the Gambler Level, that is the "player level" that you'll get experience for just by doing expeditions, levelling up your Gambler Level will unlock content that don't belong to any specific clan.

[i](Again, W.I.P)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fg7WSCA.png[/img]

Different ways of ending an expedition will result in different amounts and types of rewards, with those being EXP, skill points and currency.

We'll talk more about that in the future, since there is a lot to show, let me show you some of the new characters!

[h1]Warden and Randomized Characters[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ie3JGOw.gif[/img]
The Warden is a demon skull that smokes souls, you'll always find him smoking on the left side of the counter at The Inn.

[i](Again, all UIs are still W.I.P)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AcNDUD1.gif[/img]

The souls that aren't good enough to be smoked, are sold.
You can acquire characters and pets from different clans by talking to him and paying the price.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pPZojfu.png[/img]

Previously (in the demo), pets and characters always had the same appearance, stats and traits, with the only variation being in the gender, that you could choose.

But we decided to change that, and now all those characteristics are randomized, so you can now have completely different characters even if they are from the exact same clan!

To support that however, we are remaking all the character templates from scratch, and that takes a bit of time. (They are already in game, but still need to have a lot of things tuned, and we didn't make the clothing for them yet.)

Before (Appearance):
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XbcbEJD.gif[/img]

After (Still being tuned):
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bOf9gRr.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZXqsFS3.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QDjDr0K.gif[/img]

We still have plans to add more randomized appearance traits, such as body proportions, scars and more. (Besides adding more variation of hairstyles, faces, etc. of course.)

[h1]What else!?[/h1]
A lot more, we didn't even touch on Skill Trees and Tower Dangers yet, but I'll let those be properly talked about on another day. :)

With that said, we have [b]two very cool announcements[/b] for this month, and I hope that I can share those with you as soon as possible!
[url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Join our Discord[/url] if you want to be one of the first to know what we are doing.

I hope to see you guys soon, and stay tuned for announcements!

notes.title: February Status Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It has been around a month since the last time I've posted here, but we are still very much active in the development of Gamble Tower.

This post is not going to contain a lot of images or GIFs (if any at all) it's more a "status update" of some kind to literally update you on how the development is going, when can you expect the Early Access release and what content is going to be in it.

If you want to see how the development is going in depth, I recommend that you watch our new 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E-akWBiOYgU&t=831s&ab_channel=IndiebuildTeam]January Devlog[/url].

[h2]How is development going?[/h2]
Development is going well, not necessarily the fastest it ever was but I can say for sure that the progress for the initial Early Access release is around 65% finished.
The plan is to be able to progress by 10-15% each month until we reach the point where it's safe to announce a release date again. (probably around 90% finished?)

[h2]What was developed and what is being developed during February?[/h2]
We just finished the entirety of the second tower chapter/segment (With new enemies, bosses, etc.) and this month we want to "blockout" (make an unpolished version of) the entirety of the Early Access release, containing every single system and mechanic that we want to be present on the release.

If everything works out smoothly, by April we should have the EA more or less 80% done.

[h2]What are those systems that are being made?[/h2]
Mainly meta and non meta-progression features, such as:
[list]
[*] Permanent currencies that you can exchange for upgrades.
[*] Randomized characters with skill trees. (Instead of choosing a clan, you'll buy characters and progress them if they come back alive)
[*] Unlockables and XP
[*] Tower Dangers (Difficulty System)
[/list]

Basically 90% of those features are going to be present in the Inn, the place where you go to when you finish a run.

[h2]Why is the game being released in Early Access?[/h2]
Even if the core systems of the game are going to be basically 100% present in the Early Access version of the game, we still want to add more content variety and adapt the game to the feedback that we receive from you.
We believe that by listening to what the playerbase finds fun and incrementing on that, we'll be able to have a full release with a much better game experience in the end.

[h2]When is the game planned to be released?[/h2]
Gamble Tower's Early Access release is currently scheduled to [b]Spring 2022[/b]. (Between March and June)
The full release is going to be from 6 months to 1 year after the Early Access releases.

[h2]How can I contact you or get more frequent news about Gamble Tower?[/h2]
You can contact me through the email: indiebuild@gmail.com
Or you can just join our discord and send me a message :)
[url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord Link[/url]

See you soon! And I hope to post more frequently here from now on.

notes.title: Halloween Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We just dropped the new Halloween Update (for Gamble Tower Demo!), that contains several UX/QOL improvements and one new challenge for experienced players.

Let’s go a bit more in-depth about the new additions present exclusively during the event, which will be available from October 1 to November 30.

[h2]A strange pumpkin appears…[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40212108/fae311406fee8d26fb1e436ea207f2c3b3560adb.gif[/img]
After entering the intersection for the first time, you’ll see a peculiar pumpkin there, it’s up to you if you want to pick it up or not.

It will only appear once per tower, and always on the first floor.
If you choose to pick it up, you must carry it with you until you get the Gemchip (you must complete the Orbots’s third gamble - Scrambled Scraps - to get the Gemchip) to be able to face the Pumpkin Lord Eskyuven.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40212108/657118a08f6c2a0f069f1b319c94afcd7bceb162.gif[/img]
Trick or Treat?
We won’t spoil this battle for you, good luck!

[h1]Interface Updates[/h1]

This update contains the first batch of updates to the user interface, our goal is to improve the experience with tweaks, and in some cases, complete redesigns of the existing UI.

[h2]Artifacts[/h2]

Now it is easier to scroll through your artifacts in your HUD, additionally, we’ve added a new Interface which allows you to see all your artifacts and their descriptions simultaneously, this interface is also used in the Artifact shop when Orbifying or Removing an Artifact.

[h2]Character HUD[/h2]

The Characters on the battlefield have received a new HUD, which is more compact in order to prevent the screen from getting too cluttered. The new HUD shows the Health and Armor with the form of Horizontal Bars, and the ATK and DEF attribute on the Left Side. Additionally, Ailments are shown on the right side, one at a time.
If you prefer the old, but larger style of HUD, you can re-enable that in the options menu.

[h2]Options menu[/h2]

Talking about the Options menu, the Menu has been entirely redesigned, and is now separated into categories, it is now much easier to find the setting you want.

[h2]More to come in the Future[/h2]

As said before, this is just the first batch of improvements to the UI. There’s much more coming in the future, including, but not limited to:
[list]
[*] A new Sidebar to check the character’s stats and Ailments.
[*] More customization options for the HUD, including Scale, the speed of which Ailments and shown and more.
[*] Better Damage Numbers and Effect descriptions.
[*] Stacking Ailment Messages within a single one (Instead of showing +1 Fury 3 times, shows +3 Fury once instead).
[*] Improvements to the Orb preview in the Pouch.
[*] And many more tweaks and improvements to existing Interfaces.
[/list]

We’ll be updating the demo’s UI along with the development of the full game, but it may take some time in between updates, as we are in the stage of development where we are heavily focusing on new features and content that will only be available in the full game.

[h1]Further updates for Demo?[/h1]
Besides the interface (and bug fixes) updates we don’t have any plans for expanding the demo’s base content, something like a very small Christmas seasonal event may happen, but it also may not (Don’t count on it).
It will depend on whether it’s doable and reasonable for us to focus on other demo updates when the time comes, but for now...

Happy Halloween!
We hope you enjoy our new version of Gamble Tower Demo!

...Trick or treat?

[h3][b]Where can I share feedback?[/b][/h3]
Feel free to share feedback through our Steam Community Hub, Discord (https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx) or email! (indiebuild@gmail.com), I'll respond you directly as soon as I see the message :)

notes.title: Demo Incoming!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
We are very happy to announce that on October 1st we are going to be releasing a free demo for Gamble Tower.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/steamworks_docs/english/brazilian_portuguese.png[/img]
The game will be part of the next Steam Next Fest [i](as I really don't know how much info we can share about the event, we'll leave at that for now haha)[/i] and we hope you may get to know our project a little better through this demo.

[h1]What is going to be available on the demo? [/h1]
All three clans (Humans, Elfs and Demons) are going to be available during the demo playthrough, albeit with some limitations (no unlockables and some orbs and artifacts may be unavailable during the demo)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1NMa3KG.gif[/img]
We decided to make the entire first segment playable during the demo, which contains 5 regular battles, multiple events/shopkeepers and a boss battle against the Orbots.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wHatho9.gif[/img]
The tower is randomly generated on each run so be sure to try out every clan combination you wish and see what fits you the best, there always will be a new challenge for you to find on new runs.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OmfTptF.gif[/img]
We sincerely hope you enjoy it.

[h1]What is going to be available on the full game that is not on the demo? [/h1]
The Inn (permanent upgrades, tower dangers, etc.), other segments, bosses, save and load, tower regeneration, unlockables, several artifacts, orbs, crystals and more.

[h1]What are we working on currently? [/h1]
Besides the demo, which is currently what we are working on, we were working on Noxaerudeux, the second segment's boss who uses coin flips to apply different effects on the arena and on the characters.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tbSuljQ.gif[/img]
And we also were working on the end of the tower, developing a unlock system tied to the Inn and a sacrifice system that lets you regenerate the tower with your current character and some spoils (you could say that is a New Game+?) but on a harder difficulty and with some new challenges.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DiXBoIl.gif[/img]

[h1]Early Access when? [/h1]
We really would like to reveal a definitive release date for the Early Access version of the game, but for now I'll just say that it's releasing this year and very possibly around November or December.

There is a lot of small bugs, polishes and implementations that need to be done so the game feels appropriate for shipping, and with the demo version being around soon we'll have a lot more of feedback (and consequently polishes and bugs) to take care of.

We hope you understand.

With that said, we look forward to see what you think about Gamble Tower when the demo releases, if you have any feedback, comment or anything you wish to say related to the game, just let me know and I will gladly answer as soon as I can.
Thank you for reading and supporting Gamble Tower.
- Ian

notes.title: Some Updates!
notes.content:
Hey there! We hope you are doing well.

It has been a while since we posted anything on Steam, so we wanted to share a little bit of what we are doing right now.

We are still learning how to use the platform properly for announcements, but I hope each post is a little bit better than the one before :)

[h1]Features[/h1]
We are currently working on several core features that will be necessary to achieve a full (and satisfying) roguelite deckbuilder experience for Gamble Tower, most of the time-consuming features being the permanent progression related ones, albeit there are always those [i]pesky little bugs[/i] that always takes a toll on us and on the clock.

The progress made on the content itself is going to be listed below, there are lots of things that we made within the development time we had so far, but we chose to talk about the most interesting things.

[h2]Inn[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dk2XzYQ.jpg[/img]
The inn (still very WIP) is going to be where you'll go after finishing a run, this is where you will be able to [b]buy permanent upgrades[/b], [b]interact with merchants[/b] for [strike]not completely[/strike] entirely legal purchases and carefully select the [b]tower's dangers [/b](the game's difficulty system) between each new run.

[h2]Orb Upgrade System[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QAr3CCn.png[/img]
Another very recent addition to our cast of merchants was the [b]Crystal Hobgoblin[/b], an unfortunate creature who is forced to sell you [b]upgrade crystals that you can attach to your orbs in order to create very interesting effects and synergies[/b]. (and of course, increase your overall power)

[h2]More Content Variety in General[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ttcbl0a.gif[/img]
Despite the content we already have inside the game, we still want to add a lot of variety to the game's existing mechanics, such as orbs, more upgrade crystals, enemies, segments, bosses and if possible, NPCs.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IAGtvH6.png[/img]
Of course, this is not our top priority since our main goal when releasing Gamble Tower as an Early Access game is to be able to add that variety while you can play the game by yourself. (and hopefully give us feedback and ideas that we would love to add to the game!)

[h1]How is development going? Is there a release date?[/h1]
Unfortunately there is no official release date that we can yet make available to the public, we are currently not working full-time in Gamble Tower, therefore we don't want to announce any date that we would not be able to commit to properly.
The game will still release this year as Early Access and we will keep posting updates as frequently as we can (on Twitter too, if you so wish to follow us there!), but for now, we'll abstain from making a reckless announcement.

We hope you like the game when it is finally ready.
Thank you for reading! Expect news soon.
- Ian.

notes.title: Postponed Early Access
notes.content:
Hey there! Hope everything is going well with you.

We choose to postpone the game's Early Access release to a TBA date for several reasons we will list below, we'll keep you updated about that, but the game will still release this year (and very soon!)

The choice was made so we have more time to deliver a more polished product and, specially, because we want to make sure that we have a proper framework and workflow ready to listen to feedback and make frequent updates and fixes afterwards, when the Early Access gets released.

Overall, we want you to have a better experience in the end, and we sincerely think this decision will end up being the best one for the game!

If you have any questions or just want to receive some news, you can reach us through Steam or Twitter, where we are most active.

Thank you! Ian.
